periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight tilt towards the muzzle, approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Strongly oval with high vertical elongation, significantly taller than it is wide.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Noticeable downward taper extending from the geometric center towards the lower cheek region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation between ears, distance is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth and rounded semicircular profile at the ear apex.
